Political Science: Global Politics

Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam

← Back to search
About this programme

A reliable curriculum comparison is currently unavailable. The external curriculum has unresolved requirements; no complete degree pathway is certified here.

VU Global Politics studies political power and changing relationships between states and other actors. Students examine comparative politics, international relations, governance, the EU, political economy, security and political theory, and develop quantitative, qualitative, writing and debating skills.

A complete comparison awaits confirmation of the final-year requirements for entrants to the new curriculum from 2025–2026. The verified subset below contains 120 EC in years one and two and 30 EC of open study. No UCR alternative is presented while the remaining capstone allocation is unresolved. This does not establish that a UCR response is impossible.

Academic year: 2026–2027

Verified subset: 150 of 180 EC. The OER labels its 6/6/18 EC final-year schedule for an older cohort. The prospectus names the later courses without confirming that allocation for new entrants. Each Social Science for Society row is one restricted 6 EC choice. English language testing, thesis-entry, attendance and elective approval conditions apply.
